name: offline-cache
title: Offline cache
summary: Persists the queries marked `meta: { persist: true }` to SQLite, so the last list stays readable offline and on a cold start; a new app version never reads the old cache.
when: People open the app on a weak or no connection and expect yesterday's content.
claudeRules: Only queries with `meta: { persist: true }` are written to disk — never one that holds tokens or another person's data. The cache is busted by `APP_VERSION`.
